name: Laboratory Convex Spherical Mirror & Reflection
semanticDescription: Laboratory spherical convex (diverging) front-surface silver mirror mounted in a brass bezel on a vertical chrome support post and studio slate plinth with leveling screws. Paired with a ray optics reflection demonstration showing parallel light rays reflecting outwards into a diverging beam, with virtual backward extensions meeting behind the mirror at virtual focus F and center C, explaining its application as a vehicle rear-view mirror for CBSE Class 10 optics.
